How I work
01

AI Product Design

From model capability to a flow people trust, prompts, states, guardrails and the UI around them.

Who it's for
Teams with a working model and a product that doesn't yet feel trustworthy.
Timeline
4–8 weeks
  • Workflow map of where the model meets the user
  • Prompt, loading, uncertainty, error and recovery states
  • Coded prototype your engineers can ship from
  • Evaluation plan: what "trust" means and how we measure it
Email me about this
02

Design System Build

Tokens, accessible components and spec files your engineers and AI agents can both consume.

Who it's for
Products with two or more surfaces, or two or more brands, rebuilding the same UI.
Timeline
6–12 weeks
  • Primitive → semantic → component token architecture, themeable per brand
  • Core component set, WCAG 2.2 AA, in Figma and code
  • 8-section spec file per component
  • Storybook, contribution rules and a changelog
Email me about this
03

UX Audit and Redesign

A measured teardown against UX laws and WCAG 2.2, then the redesign that moves the number.

Who it's for
Live products with a conversion, engagement or accessibility problem you can name.
Timeline
2 weeks audit · 4–6 weeks redesign
  • Scored audit: UX laws, cognitive load, WCAG 2.2 AA
  • Prioritised fixes with expected impact
  • Redesigned flows as coded prototypes
  • Before/after measurement plan

Good to know

Before you write

Do you work with in-house teams or only as an outside partner?

Both. Companies hiring a senior or principal designer can download the resume on the home page; clients get a fixed-scope engagement with me doing the work.

What do you need from us to start?

Access to the product, one decision-maker, and the number you want to move. Design files and research are welcome but not required, I'll audit what exists in the first week.

How do you hand off?

As code and spec files, not just mock-ups: tokens, components, states and a changelog your engineers, and your AI tools, can read without me in the room.
